CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_enqueue_orderShipments_insert" AFTER INSERT ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "orderShipments" ("orderId", "note") VALUES (NEW."id", NEW."note")
    ON CONFLICT ("orderId") WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_enqueue_orderShipments_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD."note" IS NOT NEW."note")
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "orderShipments" ("orderId", "note") VALUES (NEW."id", NEW."note")
    ON CONFLICT ("orderId") WHERE state = 'ready' DO UPDATE SET note = excluded.note, due_at = excluded.due_at, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now');
END
